The article titled "Solar PV - Capacity and electricity generation" from the International Energy Agency (IEA) discusses the latest findings related to solar photovoltaic (PV) technology as of June 2026. It highlights the role of solar PV in the transition to sustainable energy systems and emphasizes the importance of collaborative projects aimed at reducing costs, analyzing barriers, and raising awareness of the potential of PV electricity.

For more detailed information, you can visit the full article [here](https://www.iea.org/energy-system/renewables/solar-pv).
